public.surface: Authenticated GET /dsh-mobile-compat/status reads the installed @deepseek-ai/dsh package.json version after connection.requestRejection(req)
connection.generation.getSnapshot()/subscribe() triggers status refresh; the plugin status route remains the release-version source
shell.overlay list Slot (entry options id and order)

structural.expectation: The data-shell-overlay parent has the Sidebar column, Center column, Rightbar column (data-rightbar-col), and overlay as its first four host children; the three columns contain the direct sidebar, main, and rightbar Slot seats. Within the main seat, ConversationRoot is reached through single-child display:contents Slot anchors (0.1.6: main.conversation), and its last direct child holds a direct data-conversation-scroll element.
[data-slot='sidebar'] has one first occupant (SidebarRoot) that only writes an inline desktop width while wide, so the mobile drawer may force it to 100%.
[data-slot='sidebar.workspaces'] resolves to WorkspaceBrowser root > section header; the search container has button[aria-expanded] and is followed by the action cluster.
The Settings modal is role=dialog, aria-modal=true, with a direct nav (title + section list) followed by its content column.

The main Slot occupant chain resolves to ConversationRoot; its last direct child contains direct data-conversation-scroll. Conversation and Composer also expose data-composer-seat, data-composer-card, and an accessible role=textbox aria-multiline=true editor.

The right panel is an absolutely positioned overlay inside the rightbar column, switched to position:fixed inset:0 for fullscreen, which is automatic below 768px viewport width. The mobile layer must keep that column displayed with a zero-width grid track and must never set display:none on it.

The conversation session header has one row for the session title/mode cluster and a later row for the view tabs. The floating sidebar toggle's clearance must be applied to the first row only (the header itself keeps DSH's native gutter), so the tab row is not indented; the toggle keeps a 44x44 hit box with a smaller visual chip that stays clear of the tab row.
